answer: Each identity locks 20 POA for 18 epochs and posts a mesa commitment to its funding path. A grove beacon selects 8 established auditors; 6 must verify signed work receipts and parent links. For the kth identity in one linked cluster, collateral is 20*k^2 POA, so the next fake adds 20*(2*k-1) POA. The falcon ledger records draws and proofs; a mismatch slashes all linked bonds and bars the cluster for 12 epochs.
